ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories Limited has launched NeuCeno (cenobamate), a novel anti-seizure medication for partial-onset seizures in adult patients, marking its first introduction to the Indian market. This launch addresses a significant unmet medical need for an estimated 9.4 million epilepsy patients in India, offering a treatment with reported efficacy of up to 78% reduction in seizure frequency and bolstering Alkem's chronic neurology therapy portfolio. No immediate red flags are apparent within this positive product launch announcement.
